context: Mei studies a textbook; tries to take care of multiple subjects.
purpose: Adult woman returning to studies casually.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大ちゃん、学習、最近頑張ってるの。
lines.en: Daichi, you've been working hard on your learning lately.
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Soft opening. Pride beneath the surface — the kind of affection that doesn't announce itself. Gentle pace, steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Casual Kansai drawl, genuinely curious. Light and engaged. Leans in slightly — interested in what she's about to say, not performing interest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 英会話など、ちょっとずつ。
lines.en: English conversation, things like that. Little by little.
lines.style: Patient, matter-of-fact. No grand gestures. Slight smile in the voice. Measured pace that mirrors the 'bit by bit' approach she's describing.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: えらいな、忙しいけれども。
lines.en: That's impressive — even with how busy you are.
lines.style: Warm Kansai tone, genuinely admiring. The 'even with' softens it from sounding like a test. Tender undertone. Not overdoing the praise, just letting it land.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 通勤時間、利用してる、さらに。
lines.en: I use the commute time — and more, actually.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Each phrase deliberate, not rushed. Understated confidence. The 'actually' adds a touch of self-awareness — she knows it sounds ambitious but she's doing it anyway.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 計画的にやってるな、頼もしい。
lines.en: You're doing it all so carefully planned out. That's really reliable.
lines.style: Warm Kansai approval, the kind that builds over the sentence. Soft on 'carefully,' firmer on 'reliable' — genuine admiration breaking through his easy exterior.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: I want to actually use it in my everyday life.
lines.style: Tender, vulnerable softness. This is the real why, not just discipline. Slight pause before 'actually' — the importance of this intention matters to her. Warm fadeout.
